raw_text: Allpa 35L Travel Pack. Price $230. Capacity 35L. Dimensions 22 x 12 x 10in (56 x 30 x 25cm). Weight 2 lb 15 oz (1.33kg). Better weight distribution and air mesh shoulder straps for an ultra-comfortable carry. Tuckable shoulder straps and hip belt. Designed to transfer weight to hip belt. Ergonomically comfortable shoulder straps. Suitcase-style, full-wrap zipper opening. Internal pocket configuration: one large, one medium and one small. Stretch mesh water bottle pocket. Front zip accessory pocket with internal organization and key clip. 15-inch padded and fleece-lined laptop sleeve. Security anti-theft YKK zippers. Shell: 100% recycled 840D TPU-coated nylon and recycled 840D ballistic ripstop nylon.
